model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of new confirmed COVID-19 cases and the number of new cases during the period from July 15, 2022, to August 26, 2022. The horizontal axis represents the date, ranging from July 15, 2022, to August 26, 2022, with dates spaced approximately every seven days. The vertical axis on the left displays the number of new confirmed COVID-19 cases, labeled in thousands, with a scale ranging from 0 to 600,000, and tick intervals of 200,000. The vertical axis on the right displays the number of new cases during the COVID-19 period, labeled in thousands, with a scale ranging from 0 to 600,000, and tick intervals of 200,000. The bars are grouped, with the blue bars representing the total number of new confirmed COVID-19 cases and the green bars representing the number of new cases during the COVID-19 period. The blue bars generally range in height from approximately 200,000 to 1,800,000, with a peak value of approximately 1,750,000 on July 22, 2022. The green bars range in height from approximately 100,000 to 400,000, with a peak value of approximately 400,000 on July 22, 2022. The bars are not sorted in any particular order.
